card.name: Slots just before 'strength' or intensity words
card.fires_on: Small words like how, was, the, very, as, be that come right before an expected word about strength or intensity (intense, strong, potentiated, stronger). It fires on the word before the strength term, not on the term itself.

modes.description: Words in descriptions of currents, gravity or sunlight where strength is about to be stated.
